user.title: Add a Zendure set
user.description: ZEM reads the set over the local network. Nothing is written to the set in this version.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Zendure set. HEMS must be off in the Zendure app.

discovery_confirm.title: Zendure set found
discovery_confirm.description: {model} with {packs} packs ({capacity} kWh), serial number {serial}, at {host}. Add it to ZEM?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the set or its answer is not usable. Check the address; if it still fails, turn HEMS on once in the Zendure app, leave the menu and turn it off again.

abort.already_configured: This set is already part of ZEM.
abort.set_added: Set {number} has been added to ZEM.
abort.cannot_connect: The set could not be reached.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Zendure set. HEMS must be off in the Zendure app.

reconfigure.title: Capacity of the set
reconfigure.description: ZEM recognises most Zendure batteries by itself. Only enter the total capacity of this set when a pack is not recognised. 0 = automatic.

data_description.capacity_override: Total capacity of all batteries of this set together, in kWh. 0 = automatic from the pack table.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the set or its answer is not usable. Check the address; if it still fails, turn HEMS on once in the Zendure app, leave the menu and turn it off again.

abort.already_configured: This set is already part of ZEM.

serial_mismatch.title: Different set at the address of set {number}
serial_mismatch.description: The device at {host} reports a different serial number than set {number}. ZEM does not use it. Check the IP address of the set (for example a fixed address in your router), or remove set {number} and add it again.

unknown_pack.title: Battery of set {number} not recognised
unknown_pack.description: ZEM does not recognise these batteries: {packs}. The capacity of set {number} is therefore too low. Enter the total capacity via ZEM → Set {number} → Reconfigure. Want to help? Report the model and the line above in a GitHub issue, and we will add the battery.

init.title: Sources and battery
init.description: Choose the sensor of your smart meter (P1) in W, + when drawing from the grid. ZEM runs in shadow mode: it calculates what it would do, but does not control the battery yet.

data_description.p1_entity: A meter that reports every second controls best. With corrections (EV, air conditioning) you can choose the corrected sensor of your current setup.
data_description.min_soc: Below this value ZEM stops delivering. Written to the set once ZEM controls it.
data_description.max_soc: Above this value ZEM stops charging. Written to the set once ZEM controls it.
